assets.prompt:
Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: 1. `hms-outdoor-gym-park-v1.png` (2400 x 1400): a set of green-painted outdoor gym stations (a pull-up bar, a cross-trainer, a sit-up bench) on rubber matting in a suburban park, a path, a single unlit light pole some distance away, a car park beyond; late-afternoon light; the equipment new and clean, nobody using it. No signs with text, no logos, no people, hands or faces anywhere in the image.

Hand-in to `status.md`; provenance `docs/production/claude-pm/assets/hms-y11-a16-provenance.json`.
